notes: The first release of Stagecraft, a free presentation app for Windows: 10 themes with 3 colour variants each, 16 smart layouts, Morph transitions and a presenter view.
Charts, tables, 1,111 icons, shapes and connectors, a command palette (Ctrl+K), a slide sorter and an outline view.
Exports PDF (vector, with selectable text), PNG and JPG, and PowerPoint (.pptx); opens PowerPoint files as a copy.
Stagecraft checks this feed shortly after it starts and at most once a day, and installs a newer version after checking its SHA-256 checksum.
